raw_context: WELCOME2DTQ — abbreviation for Downtown Quezon City; used as a hood identity marker and area pride tag in PH street rap
"Downtown kinaladkad ang QC, kami may ari nito" — Hev Abi, WELCOME2DTQ; dragged/controlled (the territory), used in boastful street dominance context
"totoo lang ako, 'di ako balagbag" — Hev Abi, WELCOME2DTQ; means fake, poser, or phony; someone putting on a front
"'Di ka uubra masyado akong presko" — Hev Abi, WELCOME2DTQ; means cool, fresh, unfazed, unbothered; used to project confidence
"todo na kalaban, 'di pa 'ko malaglag" — Hev Abi, WELCOME2DTQ; to fall, fail, be defeated or knocked out of contention
"Puro tolongges na manggi" — Hev Abi, Headshot; pretentious people, fakes, show-offs, those who act tough without substance
"na ako ang kabet" — Hev Abi, Headshot; the other person in an affair, the secret lover or mistress/paramour
Complex Philippines EIC Gelo Lasin described Hev Abi's lyrics as 'maangas' — proud, fierce, tough, badass; street swagger without aggression
"Julie Pakipot" — Hev Abi track title from mixtape 'bahay namin maliit lamang' (2024); playing hard to get, acting coy or uninterested despite mutual attraction
"pasulyap-sulyap" — Hev Abi track title from mixtape 'bahay namin maliit lamang' (2024); to steal glances or keep sneaking looks at someone, often flirtatiously
"Babaero" by gins&melodies feat. Hev Abi — #1 on Billboard PH for 5 weeks (2024); a womanizer, a man who chases or pursues many women
Referenced in 'Lil Kasalanan Shortie' lyrical context; to go wild, party hard, lose all restraint; youth party/nightlife slang
Referenced in 'Lil Kasalanan Shortie' lyrical context; rebellious, naughty, someone who doesn't follow rules or authority
"Headshot naglakad payuko" — Hev Abi, Headshot; walking with head bowed down, defeated or humiliated; used as a diss toward rivals
"Mantitrip muna sa mga mas malakas ako" — Hev Abi, Headshot; to mess with, challenge, or disrespect someone; picking a fight or testing someone's patience
